arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Eric Fox argued the product liability loss is a subset of the net operating loss.
Fox cited the district court's finding on page 36A of Appendix B.
Fox noted legislative history shows concern about delayed product liability suits.
Fox explained products might generate income before liability claims arise years later.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: United Dominion Industries seeks to treat a product liability loss as a net operating loss. The United States opposes this classification. The case tests the scope of tax loss deductions.

The United States wants the Court to deny the offset and uphold the tax assessment.
